description: Find the FactLot URN for an ID from another system, e.g. system "sdat_account" (a Maryland SDAT account number) or, where Texas is hosted, "hcad_account" (a Harris CAD account number). Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

system.description: Crosswalk system name, e.g. "sdat_account" (Maryland), or "hcad_account" where Texas is hosted.

name: registry_resolve_external
title: Resolve an external ID
